name: presidents-pentagon-papers-tonkin.pdf
description: The Pentagon Papers-style declassified history, Vol. IV.C "Evolution of the War: Direct Action, The Johnson Commitments, 1964-1968," covering U.S. military pressures against North Vietnam from July to October 1964, including the Gulf of Tonkin incidents, the Tonkin Gulf Resolution, NSAM 314, and related Laos operations and deliberations.
